reviewer: AI visual review of all 63 native-crop failure contact-sheet entries

categories.name: two_line_layout
categories.note: Visible two-line layout; full-crop reader misses or substitutes characters.

categories.name: reference_or_transcription_review
categories.note: Possible publisher transcription or confusable-character issue. Entry 4 visibly supports the OCR reading rather than the XML reference. All need independent human adjudication; this does not mean all 12 references are wrong.

categories.name: occluded_or_clipped
categories.note: Objects cover characters or the plate extends beyond the crop. Missing pixels cannot be established by OCR certainty.

categories.name: light_text_on_red_special_layout
categories.note: Light lettering and special/transit-style layout are outside the usual dark-on-light single row.

categories.name: extra_or_missing_characters
categories.note: Largely legible glyphs but inserted, repeated or omitted characters; decoding/layout analysis is warranted.

categories.name: perspective_or_rotation
categories.note: Oblique or rotated view; not proof that affine deskew alone will fix recognition.

categories.name: small_or_blurred_glyphs
categories.note: Small, blurred or low-contrast characters requiring individual readability review; not a claim every example is unreadable.
